facts.fact: The article was published on April 6, 2022.

StackAdapt defines personalized marketing as messaging tailored to an individual or specific audience and refined by where they are in their relationship with the brand, using data such as purchase history and demographics in digital advertising.
facts.quote: Personalized marketing is when messaging is tailored to an individual or a specific audience, and further refined by where they’re at in their relationship with your brand.

facts.fact: The page defines personalization as knowing the needs, preferences, and interests of current and target audiences so digital campaigns can deliver what they are looking for at the moment they are looking for it.
facts.quote: Personalization is all about knowing the needs, preferences, and interests of your current and target audience.
